comment: Recorded-response fixtures for tests/grower.test.js (LOCAL_LLM.md §5.7 payoff 3, §7). `props` stands in for GET /props; `completions` maps the target state's expr — the last `State:` line of the rendered prompt — to the branch payload the stub transport returns. Shapes match what the reference server actually emits (stop_type eos, stopped_limit null). Designed to exercise: the width cap (three proposals at the root), a valid rejoin (red_woods), an invalid rejoin (no_such_node), a cycle-creating rejoin (red_start from its own descendant), a grown-to-grown merge (shelter(red, cottage) proposed on two parallel paths), and a grown-to-SEED merge (arrive(red, grandmother_house) is red_arrive's own expr). The two merge cases use different exprs on purpose: seeds v2 made arrive(red, grandmother_house) a real seed node, which silently turned the old grown-to-grown case into a grown-to-seed one and cost the test its subject. shelter(red, cottage) appears in no seed and must stay that way.

branches.label: Filler beyond the width cap
branches.state: This proposal sorts last and must be cut by width=2.

branches.label: Mother comes along
branches.state: Mother walks with Red; the woods hold no unsupervised stranger contact.

branches.label: Red refuses the errand
branches.state: Red stays home; the basket never enters the woods.
branches.invariants: the wolf has not seen Red

branches.label: They wait out the day
branches.state: The pair stops at a woodsman's cottage until the light is better.

branches.label: They turn back
branches.state: The pair abandons the trip at the treeline.

branches.label: Red relents and arrives
branches.state: Red reaches the house before any predator does.

branches.label: Red waits it out instead
branches.state: Red stops at a woodsman's cottage until the light is better.
